founder_review_correction.description: build_order_intent and confirm_and_send had no mutual exclusion across separate OS processes sharing one durable journal; two genuine separate processes racing the identical proposal each created a distinct order_intent_id, with one silently lost from the durable file.
founder_review_correction.correction: added _CrossProcessFileLock (atomic exclusive-file-creation mutex, owner-token-verified release, bounded stale-lock recovery) and _ThreadLock to mt5_execution_journal.py; ExecutionJournalWriter.acquire_creation_lock() wraps both critical sections and reloads from disk on acquisition; new EXECUTION_LOCK_UNAVAILABLE reason code fails closed on contention.
founder_review_correction.secondary_defect_found_during_correction: the lock's original release() unconditionally unlinked whatever file existed at the lock path, which would have deleted a different owner's live lock after a stale-lock break; fixed with a unique owner token checked before unlink
